title: Implement a release-note policy from a written specification
prompt: changelog.py assembles release notes, but `is_user_visible` ignores the policy. The full specification is in docs/policy.md — five numbered rules plus ordering and fragment behaviour. Read it, then implement `is_user_visible` so the rules hold, and make `collect_entries` raise on a missing fragment rather than skipping it. The tests in tests/ encode every rule; run them.
